definition.def: When people interact with each other or interact, they communicate as they work or spend time together.
examples: While the other children interacted and played together, Ted ignored them. [VERB]
...rhymes and songs to help parents interact with their babies. [VERB + with]

definition.def: When people interact with computers, or when computers interact with other machines, information or instructions are exchanged.
examples: Millions of people want new, simplified ways of interacting with a computer. [VERB + with]
There will be a true global village in which phones, computers and televisions interact. [VERB]

definition.def: When one thing interacts with another or two things interact, the two things affect each other's behaviour or condition.
examples: You have to understand how cells interact. [VERB]
Atoms within the fluid interact with the minerals that form the grains. [VERB + with]
